purpose: Bound the phrase all ecologically meaningful interactions to interactions already motivated by the pre-colour hypothesis registry and frozen source families, rather than an unbounded mathematical search.

families.members: all 10 unordered pairwise interactions among thermal_regime, water_balance, atmospheric_energy_dryness, edaphic_regime and terrain_structure

ecological_interpretations: abiotic context may strengthen, weaken or reverse pollinator-associated colour sorting
climate and terrain can restructure pollinator communities and flower exposure simultaneously
soil/resource context may alter the cost-benefit balance of pigment under pollinator-mediated selection
families.multiplicity_rule_when_opened: freeze all evaluable environment-by-pollinator members together and Holm-correct across that complete family
families.current_blocker: exact GloBI and GBIF pollinator payload/checksum and coverage rules are not currently frozen as executable RGFCA inputs

ecological_interpretations: restricted connectivity may allow environmentally associated colour differentiation to persist
the same environmental contrast may produce stronger phenotypic separation across a dispersal barrier
barriers may substitute for or synergize with environmental turnover
families.multiplicity_rule_when_opened: freeze all evaluable environment-by-barrier members together and Holm-correct across them
families.current_source_state: RESOLVE is exact and evaluated; Natural Earth, HydroRIVERS and GMBA exact executable payloads still require freezing/verification before this family can run

ecological_interpretations: barriers may stabilize geographically distinct pollinator mosaics and thereby strengthen colour differentiation
pollinator turnover without isolation may be transient whereas coincident pollinator turnover and barriers may produce stronger spatial phenotypic structure
families.multiplicity_rule_when_opened: freeze all evaluable pollinator-by-barrier members together and Holm-correct across them

families.unit: matched sympatric versus outcome-blind allopatric species-pair contrast
ecological_interpretations: shared environmental filtering can drive convergence
reproductive interference or discrimination can drive divergence
the sign of community assembly may change with phylogenetic, phenological and pollination context
families.guard: these are not edge-level interactions and must not be mixed into E1-E4 multiplicity families

families.unit: species or population-level moderator analysis depending source
guards: SC/SI cannot substitute for quantitative autofertility
dynamic climate must use temporally resolved data rather than static BIO seasonality
trait moderators are not evidence of morph-specific fitness by themselves

explicit_exclusions: all mathematical three-way and higher interactions without a separately frozen mechanistic hypothesis
interactions between two alternative measurements of the same construct when the purpose is only measurement agreement rather than ecology
variable-by-variable interaction mining from unsupported block-level pairs
post-result thresholds, sign flips, subsets or source substitutions
execution_order: freeze exact external payloads and coverage gates for E2-E4 before any cross-domain interaction outcome
execute E2-E4 as separate complete families only when their required sources are evaluable
execute G5 community context as its own matched-design programme
open E6 only when quantitative temporal or trait data pass coverage gates
